The gate ran every existing suite (all green), and the reviewers inspected the fix features' regression coverage, finding: scale.test.ts:86-100 never asserts a successful reflow leaves `unresolvable` empty (so the partial-plan path is untested), and the oracle/property suite have no assertions for search/hold agreement, monotonic release, atomic modify or overbook isolation, although engine.property.test.ts titles claim I1-I8.

discoveredIssues.description: fnd-fix-domain-contract-compliance: reflowDay passes Math.min(MAX_REPAIR_EXPANSIONS=200, remainingBudget) into each nested placement (packages/reservations/src/engine/assign.ts:1079); when that sub-budget is exhausted while the 5,000 day budget is not, assign.ts:1137-1148 marks the booking unresolvable and continues, so reflow returns a partially applied plan (moves for some bookings) with status 'no_fit' and budgetExhausted:false - architecture.md:1196-1197 requires 'no fit' and never a partial plan when a budget is exhausted, and the normative research gives booking placement the 2,000 book budget.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Pass Math.min(MAX_BOOK_EXPANSIONS, remainingBudget) into the nested assignTables call (or treat any nested budget exhaustion as the day-level no-fit reset), assert `unresolvable.length === 0` for a successful reflow in scale.test.ts, and remove the now-competing MAX_DAY_EXPANSIONS/MAX_REPAIR_EXPANSIONS vocabulary.

discoveredIssues.description: fnd-fix-domain-contract-compliance: the property suite runs the required random operation sequences with per-step verification (testing/arbitraries.ts:520-954, engine.property.test.ts:128-147) but does not verify the required invariant semantics - no search-then-hold agreement, no monotonic release (nothing compares availability before/after cancel/seat/finish), no atomic-modify check (arbitraries.ts:722-766 cannot surface a partial mutation) and no staff-overbook isolation - while the oracle labels I6/I7/I8 on pacing caps (oracle.ts:229-261), channel/mode eligibility (76-177) and interval/service-window checks (78-81,179-199). VAL-FND-009, mission.md's invariants list and skills/domain-worker step 3 require those semantics.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Add per-step checks (hold a searched slot against identical state and clock; compare availability before/after cancel/finish/shrink; assert a failed modify leaves the reservation and occupancies unchanged; exercise overbook isolation), relabel the oracle to one canonical invariant list, and map each named invariant to its assertion in the handoff.

discoveredIssues.description: fnd-fix-db-backend-app-and-docs-compliance: the KSA local tenant DB used by services.yaml tenant-api-ksa (packages/database/db/ksa/tenant_ru0dm42cud9scs4g2duep21c.db) still carries the pre-fix triggers ('table_overlap', EXISTS filter without `o.overbook = 0`, and WHEN OLD.status='converted' AND NEW.status='converted'), so the fix's own expectedBehavior clause 'workers/migrations.generated.ts and seeded local US/KSA tenant DBs are in sync' is only 2/3 met and the round-1 trigger defect is still observable on the local KSA data plane; __drizzle_migrations already records 0016 and tenant DB files must not be deleted, so re-seeding cannot heal it. No validation-contract tool reads that artifact (VAL-FND-011/012 build a fresh temp DB), so the remedy is data-only, not a code change.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: DROP/CREATE the affected triggers in packages/database/db/ksa/tenant_ru0dm42cud9scs4g2duep21c.db with the 0016 SQL and verify sqlite_master in both TENANT_DB_DIR roots; consider one reusable refresh command/helper for future in-place migration corrections.

discoveredIssues.description: Docs drift written by the fix in files later milestones copy from: ADR 048 section 5 and docs/reservations-plan.md:27-38 name non-existent triggers and abort strings (rsv_holds_no_overlap_*, rsv_events_*_no_update/_delete, 'rsv_reservation_holds overlap', redaction via NEW.payload IS NULL); docs/permissions.md:212-216 and ADR 048:211-215 state implied-read rules that contradict packages/reservations/src/permissions.ts:59-61 and tenant-role-permissions.ts:105-111; ADR 048:44 / plan :22 say 24 rsv_* tables where 41 exist; ADR:215 says four role presets where seven are defined; ADR:255-262 overstates the erase-customer route. VAL-FND-024's bar (8 permissions + 6 flags) is met, so these are not gate failures.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Fold a documentation-accuracy pass into the next fix round (or the docs milestone) using 0016 and the code as the source of truth.

discoveredIssues.description: packages/reservations/src/time.ts:99-104: the widened-options overload claims a non-null result while the implementation can return null when opts.gap === 'skip' (time.ts:156-158); latent today because only literal option objects are passed, but a caller forwarding `opts` through a variable would get a compile-time non-null type and a runtime TypeError.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Make the widened overload return the nullable resolution type (or split the option types so 'skip' cannot be widened into the non-null overload).
